content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"Payments calls jumped from 114 at 12:00 to 154 at 12:15 and 153 at 12:30, against a forecast of about 100–110 per interval (+40% to +53%). Service level fell to 16.9% and then 4.6%, with 64 calls abandoned. The extra calls are payment_status_enquiry (1.6x normal) and refund_status (1.66x normal), which matches P2 incident INC-20261023-2029: IMPS/NEFT transfers stuck in 'pending', with accounts debited but credits not confirmed. The ticket was opened at 12:30, about 15 minutes after calls started rising, so the outage probably began before it was logged. Staffing was 36–37 agents against 36–38 planned, with only 1 absence (2.6 is usual), so this is extra demand, not missing staff.","evidence":[{"source":"incident","ref_id":"INC-20261023-2029","summary":"P2, opened 12:30: IMPS/NEFT payment hub transfers stuck pending, accounts debited but credits not confirmed, reversal job queued."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"payment_status_enquiry","summary":"178 calls vs 111 expected (+67, 1.6x normal) from 11:45 to 12:45."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"refund_status","summary":"142 calls vs 85.4 expected (+56.6, 1.66x normal), in line with debited-but-not-credited transfers."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"volume","summary":"154 and 153 calls in the 12:15 and 12:30 intervals vs forecasts of 109.7 and 100.1 (+40% and +53%)."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"service_level","summary":"Fell from 100% at 12:00 to 16.9% and then 4.6%, with 26 and 38 calls abandoned."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"staffing","summary":"36–37 agents on the phones vs 36–38 planned, so capacity was close to plan."},{"source":"attendance","ref_id":"attendance_log","summary":"Payments has 1 absence vs the usual 2.6, so there is no sick wave."}],"flagged_injections":[]}
